## Browse methods

The [Methods library](methods.qmd) is the primary entry point. It brings
together six analytical families, with each page linked to the canonical source
file in this repository.

::: {.grid}

::: {.g-col-12 .g-col-md-4 .method-card}
### [Single-cell](templates/single_cell/README.md)

Seurat workflows for object construction, QC, preprocessing, scoring,
trajectories, dynamics, and network analysis.
:::

::: {.g-col-12 .g-col-md-4 .method-card}
### [Bulk RNA](templates/bulk_rna/README.md)

Count-aware tximport/edgeR workflows, QC, enrichment, and sample-level scoring.
:::

::: {.g-col-12 .g-col-md-4 .method-card}
### [scATAC](templates/scatac/README.md)

Signac object construction, fragment-aware QC, LSI, and motif analysis.
:::

::: {.g-col-12 .g-col-md-4 .method-card}
### [Multiome](templates/multiome/README.md)

Paired RNA/ATAC WNN, peak-gene linkage, and directional label transfer.
:::

::: {.g-col-12 .g-col-md-4 .method-card}
### [Multi-omics / MOFA](templates/multiomics/mofa/README.md)

MOFA2 view preparation, unsupervised factor modeling, diagnostics, and
interpretation.
:::

::: {.g-col-12 .g-col-md-4 .method-card}
### [Biomarker ML](templates/machine_learning/biomarkers/README.md)

Sample-level bias-reduced biomarker classification and frozen model reporting.
:::

## Repository philosophy

The repository keeps meaningful scientific decisions, diagnostics, practical
notes, and source provenance visible. Templates are reminders and reusable
workflows, not packages, clinical pipelines, or replacements for official
documentation.

## Other resources

- [Examples](examples.qmd) preserve real project workflows and provenance.
- [Cheatsheets](cheatsheets.qmd) collect compact method references.
- [Miscellaneous resources](miscellaneous.qmd) collect documentation prompts and
  Quarto reporting guidance.

The current canonical library contains 37 templates. Templates retain their
individual validation status; the current inventory is intentionally not a
claim that every workflow has been executed end to end.
